recon.paper_id: 065_Godlewska_2018_Assessment of the effect of various bios
warnings: This is a factorial design with biostimulant x nitrogen interactions - need to extract each biostimulant vs control separately
Multiple biostimulants tested (Algex, Tytanit, Asahi SL) - each should be compared to control
Nitrogen fertilization creates two different control conditions (0 N and 30 kg/ha N)
Data aggregated across 3 years (2014-2016) and 3 cuts per year - verify if means are presented
Tables use letter notation (a,b,c) which appears to be from statistical tests rather than variance measures
Control is 'Without biostimulant' not any of the named products
WARNING: SCANNED PDF - Text may have OCR errors
WARNING: VAR-UNCLEAR - Variance type not clearly stated
recon.variance_source: Significance of differences between means was checked using the Tukey test at the significance level of a≤0.05. Different lower-case letters within the same line indicate significant differences.
recon.treatment_definition: Three biostimulant treatments: Algex (seaweed extract), Tytanit (titanium-containing), Asahi SL (phenolic compounds)
recon.potential_tc_confusion: Factorial design with nitrogen levels could create confusion - control is specifically the no-biostimulant treatment, not the no-nitrogen treatment
recon.sample_size_source: A field experiment was arranged as a randomized subblock design (splitplot) with three replicates
recon.factorial_structure: ["biostimulant type (4 levels)", "nitrogen rate (2 levels)", "year (3 levels)", "cut number (3 levels)"]
recon.extraction_guidance: Extract dry matter yield data from Tables 2 and 3. Compare each biostimulant (Algex, Tytanit, Asahi SL) against 'Without biostimulant (control)'. Handle factorial design by extracting separate comparisons for each nitrogen level. Use Tukey test results (letter notations) to assess significance. Units are in t/ha. Focus on mean values across years and cuts where available.
